transcript.transcriptText: Good morning everyone, let's get started with the Q3 review. Alice, do you want to kick us off with the roadmap update?
Sure. So we've reprioritised the Meetings integration to Q3 and pushed the billing work to Q4. The main driver is the Transcribe Tonic rollout.
That makes sense to me. The infrastructure on our end is ready to support it. We finished the capacity review last week.
Great. Bob, can you confirm the SLA targets are still achievable with the new timeline?
Yes, we're comfortable with 99.9% uptime on the webhook service. We have failover in place.
One thing I wanted to flag — we still haven't confirmed the LM Studio model selection for the processing pipeline.
That's on me. I'll have it confirmed by end of week. Qwen3 27B is the current front-runner.
Sounds good. I'll schedule a follow-up with DevOps to make sure the GPU allocation is locked in.
I'll update the roadmap deck and share it before Friday's standup.
